name: 動画圧縮トレース
description: Analyzes video compression patterns for forensic traces.
useCase: Detecting AI-generated videos through compression artifact analysis
mechanism: Examines 8x8 macroblock boundary patterns from H.264/H.265 encoding. AI-generated content may lack natural compression artifacts or show double compression traces.
source: Guera and Delp (2018) - Deepfake Video Detection Using RNNs, AVSS
algorithm: Macroblock Boundary vs Inner Block Energy Analysis
parameters: Block size: adaptive, Analysis region: face/body, Metrics: gradient energy, variance ratio
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated video artifacts
- Works across different video resolutions
- Complements other forensic analysis methods
- Low computational overhead per frame
limitations:
- Requires video input (not applicable to images)
- May produce false positives on heavily processed videos
- Performance varies with video quality
- Single-frame analysis limits temporal assessment

references.title: Guera and Delp (2018) - Deepfake Video Detection Using RNNs, AVSS
